How can [I](/person/1155) grieve and sorrow about my dear dear [Father](/person/1156)’s blessed end? . . . I shall like the photograph of Hursley Vicarage and Church, the lawn and group upon it.[^1] But most shall I like to think that [Mr.

Keble](/person/798), and I dare say [Dr.

Moberly](/person/1015) too, pray for me and this [Mission](/organisation/30). I need the prayers of all good people indeed.


[^1]: CMY introduces the letter by saying it \'contained thanks for a photograph of Hursley Church spire and Vicarage, which had been taken one summer afternoon, at the desire of Dr.

Moberly (the present Bishop of Salisbury), and of which I had begged a copy for him\'.

The photograph is probably that reproduced in [Dulce Domum](/place/122) facing page 184.

It shows Moberly and Keble standing, with CMY and Charlotte Keble seated, in the garden of Hursley Vicarage.
